Scenario.description: Values written into the models at start, and the narratives that go with them.

archiver.description: `[{channel, events}]`, the history each channel's archive shows. An event's `at_offset` is in seconds relative to the moment the scenario is applied (negative is the past); a step, spike, burst or loss may instead state `at_when` `{days_ago, time}`, a logbook entry's own `when`, so the event and the entry narrating it fall at one instant. An anchored spike's `width` is its Gaussian sigma in seconds. A burst jumps by `amplitude` at its instant and decays with `decay_s`, plus an optional slower `tail_decay_s` carrying `tail_share` of it; a loss drops by `amount` at its instant and only the channel's top-off refills it. An event meant to be sampled densely sits inside the archive's dense tier, with a `width` of at least twice the sampling interval.
